description: This file contains the implementation of a singly linked list data structure, including methods for adding, removing, retrieving elements, and computing the size of the list.

classes.name: LinkedList
classes.description: A class implementing a singly linked list with operations to add, remove, get elements, and determine the size of the list.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: A private inner class representing a node in the linked list, holding a data element and a reference to the next node.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Appends a new element to the end of the linked list.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the first occurrence of the specified element from the list, returning true if successful.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the list.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the element at the specified index.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Private method that unlinks a node from the list by adjusting pointers.

methods.name: tail
methods.description: Companion object method that returns the last node in the list starting from the head.
